blind.description: A cubic ancient stone puzzle block with polished brass or bronze corner brackets. Each face is carved with recessed relief panels showing geometric runic symbols, including an eye-like diamond-in-circle motif on the top face and vertical tribal/runic designs on the sides. The stone has a weathered, mossy greenish-grey textured finish with darker crevices. All surfaces are solid, continuous, and clean with no broken geometry, hovering elements, or unpainted patches.
blind.from_above: A square stone top face with brass corner caps and a central carved circular symbol containing an upright diamond shape.
blind.height_vs_figure: About two-thirds the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure (roughly 3.5 to 4 feet tall), and equally wide and deep.
